lessons.title: 1.1 Advanced Pakistan Studies XI–XII — core concepts
lessons.content:

Study the evolution of Pakistan's constitutional, political, social and economic institutions. Analyse federalism, citizenship, regional diversity, public policy and international relations using historical context and evidence. Distinguish constitutional principles from political commentary.
